title: ETA / Unitas 6497-2 — Exploded Watch Anatomy
summary: A movement-first 3D explainer of a large hand-wound mechanical watch with causal winding and setting, stored reserve, an integrated balance/hairspring oscillator, finite polygon escapement contact, and normalized available → delivered → lost impulse-work transfer that continuously scales each balance kick.

facts.Current pass: M5i reserve drive + M5h polygon following/contact quality → normalized delivered work → variable Δω
